commands.name: addLayer
commands.description: Add an editable layer to the active composition.

commands.name: removeLayer
commands.description: Remove an existing layer from the active composition.

commands.name: renameLayer
commands.description: Rename an existing layer.

commands.name: reorderLayer
commands.description: Move a layer to a bounded stack index.

commands.name: toggleLayer
commands.description: Toggle one supported boolean layer flag.

commands.name: setProperty
commands.description: Set a supported transform or opacity property to a finite value.

commands.name: addKeyframe
commands.description: Add a bezier keyframe to a supported property.

commands.name: addEffect
commands.description: Add a registered GPU effect to an existing layer.

commands.name: removeEffect
commands.description: Remove an effect owned by an existing layer.

commands.name: setEffectParameter
commands.description: Set a finite parameter on an effect owned by a layer.

commands.name: setTextAnimator
commands.description: Configure bounded per-character text animation on a text layer.

commands.name: setActiveComposition
commands.description: Activate an existing composition by ID.

commands.name: addComposition
commands.description: Create a bounded blank composition and optionally activate it.

commands.name: addProjectFolder
commands.description: Create a project-panel folder under an optional parent folder.

commands.name: moveProjectItem
commands.description: Move a composition or media project item into or out of a folder.

commands.name: setCompositionSettings
commands.description: Update bounded composition identity, dimensions, frame rate, and duration.

commands.name: setCompositionEnvironment
commands.description: Update or clear the active HDR environment while preserving its imported source.

commands.name: setCompositionWorkArea
commands.description: Set the frame-aligned work area of a composition.

commands.name: precomposeLayers
commands.description: Move selected layers into a generated nested composition and insert a wrapper.

commands.name: setBlendMode
commands.description: Set a supported layer blend mode.

commands.name: setParent
commands.description: Set or clear a layer parent with cycle validation.

commands.name: setLayerTiming
commands.description: Set bounded layer in and out points.

commands.name: setLayerTimeMapping
commands.description: Set layer source-time offset and stretch.

commands.name: setLayerTimeRemap
commands.description: Set or clear a validated static or keyframed layer time-remap track.

commands.name: setLayerAudioGain
commands.description: Set normalized layer audio preview gain.

commands.name: setLayerAudioSettings
commands.description: Replace bounded stereo audio levels, pan, mute, and reverse settings.

commands.name: setMaterial3d
commands.description: Replace a layer's bounded physically based material settings.

commands.name: setLightSettings
commands.description: Replace the settings of a light layer.

commands.name: setLayerColor
commands.description: Set a bounded linear RGBA layer color.

commands.name: setSolidSettings
commands.description: Replace the bounded dimensions and RGBA color of a solid layer.

commands.name: addSource
commands.description: Add one validated footage source to the project registry.

commands.name: removeSource
commands.description: Remove an unreferenced footage source.

commands.name: cleanupOrphanSources
commands.description: Remove every footage source not referenced by a layer.

commands.name: setLayerSource
commands.description: Set or clear a layer footage-source reference.

commands.name: relinkSource
commands.description: Replace the bounded locator and content identity of a footage source.

commands.name: reloadSource
commands.description: Reload source metadata and content while preserving its stable id and kind.

commands.name: interpretSource
commands.description: Replace bounded alpha, color-space, and frame-rate interpretation metadata.

commands.name: setCameraSettings
commands.description: Replace the settings of a camera layer.

commands.name: setSceneGenerator
commands.description: Replace a scene generator plugin instance and its bounded parameters.

commands.name: setClonerSettings
commands.description: Replace or clear a bounded layer cloner distribution and effector stack.

commands.name: setShapeSettings
commands.description: Replace a shape layer's bounded primitive, stroke, fill, path, and trim settings.

commands.name: setShapeGraph
commands.description: Replace or clear a validated reusable shape graph.

commands.name: setTextContent
commands.description: Set bounded text content on a text layer.

commands.name: setTextStyle
commands.description: Replace a text layer's bounded typography and stroke settings.

commands.name: moveKeyframe
commands.description: Move a transform keyframe to a bounded time.

commands.name: updateKeyframe
commands.description: Update a transform keyframe's time, value, interpolation, easing, and spatial tangents.

commands.name: removeKeyframe
commands.description: Remove an existing transform keyframe.

commands.name: easeLayer
commands.description: Apply the editor's standard easing to animated transform tracks on a layer.

commands.name: setExpression
commands.description: Set or clear a bounded expression on a supported property.

commands.name: moveEffect
commands.description: Move an owned effect to a bounded stack index.

commands.name: setEffectMask
commands.description: Replace or clear a validated effect mask.

commands.name: toggleEffect
commands.description: Toggle an owned effect's enabled state.

commands.name: setEffectLut
commands.description: Replace or clear the bounded resource on a 3D LUT effect.

commands.name: setEffectParameterAtTime
commands.description: Set an effect parameter at an explicit time using an existing or generated keyframe ID.

commands.name: addEffectParameterKeyframe
commands.description: Add a validated keyframe to an owned effect parameter.

commands.name: removeEffectParameterKeyframe
commands.description: Remove a keyframe from an owned effect parameter.

commands.name: moveEffectParameterKeyframe
commands.description: Move an effect parameter keyframe to a bounded time.
